rationale: The original short thesis relied on a low-volume bounce failing below session VWAP ($59.76) and the 5-minute 9-EMA ($59.82). Instead, a massive 126,413-share 1-minute volume spike pushed price cleanly through both levels, with the subsequent candle holding above $59.79 and closing at $59.92. With both technical resistance levels reclaimed on heavy buying volume, the setup is broken and exiting ahead of the $60.05 stop is warranted.
